digest.component_or_area: plan review gates and code review scope detection
propositions: Two regexes and one scope extractor read the `## Success Criteria` heading to make blocking decisions; the heading is load-bearing and must be repointed to `## Acceptance Criteria` before store migration can be verified.

The clarity-score epic branch currently grants +2 for `## Success Criteria` but must be repointed to `## Acceptance Criteria` without changing the overall epic score (remain at 6) to avoid regressions across 108 live migrated tickets.
Test fixtures across seven files embed `## Success Criteria` in ticket descriptions and must be updated to use `## Acceptance Criteria` with `- [ ]` checkboxes to satisfy the check-ac floor.
The two copies of the clarity-score heuristic in gates.py and det_floor.py must remain textually in lockstep per module comments; both must be repointed together.
The repoint approach (not a drop) keeps clarity-check from discriminating on the epic bonus while ensuring AC is already a universal blocking floor.
